mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: expect temperatures around 73 degrees with overcast skies near Badger Prairie County Park. We are currently under a waxing crescent moon.

The Verona Senior Center is seeking volunteers to assist with their programs. They ask for a commitment of at least two shifts per month, and while some roles require light physical activity, they are happy to discuss accommodations.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee or bring the kids to the Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Tomorrow, Epic Systems hosts their UGM event and there is yoga at Insight Wellness.
On August 6, an officer arrested a driver for an O W I, fourth offence, after observing erratic driving.
Today's flavor is Mint Cookie. The shop is currently closed but will open at 10 AM. Tomorrow's flavor will be Caramel Peanut Buttercup.
